sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for facility 234465 (catx.py: 39 sites incl. host, tent-only, group)

values.note: Single site $16/night. Group sites 7 and 23 $50/night (up to 25 people); group shelter (site 1) $100/night for 1-100 people, $200 for 101+.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/mcgillivray-campground-and-group-sites ('Single Site: $16 per night', 'Group Site: $50 per night', 'Group Shelter: $100 per night (1-100 people), $200 per night (101-max people)', page last updated May 1, 2026) + recreation.gov /rates (2026 Peak Season single-site rate 16), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/mcgillivray-campground-and-group-sites ('$16.00 daily fee per single site; 50% discount with US Golden Age/Access or Interagency Senior/Access Passes'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234465 ('All sites at this campground have no electricity') + catalog (all sites NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234465 ('McGillivray Campground has 33 total campsites') + rec.gov catalog (max vehicle length 40 ft on every RV site), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Rec.gov and the FS narrative describe accessible vault toilets and drinking water by the group shelter; the FS page's generic amenity box says 'Restrooms are not available' and 'Potable water is not available', which contradicts its own narrative.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234465 ('Two Accessible vault toilets and drinking water are provided nearby'; amenities 'Drinking Water'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 4 single sites, the 2 group sites and the group shelter are reservable on Recreation.gov; the other single sites are first-come, first-served (saving sites prohibited).

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/mcgillivray-campground-and-group-sites ('In addition to the group sites there are 4 other single sites on the reservation list') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234465 (notices '16 Day Stay Limit', 'Non-reservable sites are first come-first serve. Saving sites is prohibited.'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 16), read 2026-10-22

note: USFS Kootenai NF campground on the western shore of Lake Koocanusa, ~15 mi NE of Libby on Hwy 37 then W on FDR 228. Swim beach, picnic area and high/low-water boat ramp; large group shelter and 2 group sites. Open ~late May-early Sept. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov: confirmed $16 single site, 33 sites, 40-ft max, no electric, drinking water, vault toilets, FCFS with some reservable sites. Changed fees nightly_high 50 -> 16 (the $50 is the group-site rate). Added 16-day stay limit, rec.gov booking, Senior/Access 50% discount. Libby Ranger District (406-293-7773). No alert or closure for the campground or FDR 228. Note trimmed of restated values.
